result.question: What does the old prophet do after hearing men?

readings.answer: He went and found the body lying in the road.
readings.support: he went and found the body lying in the road

readings.answer: He lifted up the body, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his city to mourn and bury him.
readings.support: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him

readings.answer: He laid the body in his own tomb.
readings.support: Then he laid the body in his own tomb

assessments.reason: The passage states “he went and found the body lying in the road,” which is an action the old prophet takes after the preceding report; this aligns with the ‘finds body’ part of the key though it omits ‘saddles donkey.’
“So the old prophet lifted up the body… and brought it back…” are also actions he takes after the report; they fit the question’s wording though they are not the keyed action.
“Then he laid the body in his own tomb” is another subsequent action; it answers what he does after hearing, though it is later than the keyed step.

result.reason: The passage lists several actions the old prophet takes after the report without specifying which to name, so multiple materially different answers fit, while the key’s ‘saddles donkey’ detail is not in the window.
